notes.title: Patch notes 1.01
notes.notes: [p]Today marks 1 month since [i]Double Trip[/i] was released! We're incredibly grateful for all the support we've received during this time ❤️[/p][p][/p][p]We also want to thank the team at [i][b]Thinky Games[/b][/i] for publishing an article about the game! You can read it here: [url="https://thinkygames.com/features/double-trip-is-the-perfect-sokoban-for-beginners-and-those-after-a-cosy-break/"]Thinky Games - Double Trip article[/url][/p][p][/p][p]And a big thank you to [i][b]El_Yuste[/b][/i] for featuring Double Trip at [i][b]Ñ3[/b][/i], the Spanish video game conference![/p][p][/p][h1]PATCH NOTES [/h1][p][/p][h2]Quality of Life Improvements: [/h2][list][*][p]Added a confirmation popup when changing the resolution.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h2]Bugfixes: [/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where \[spoiler]the statue would disappear if the map was restarted before finishing the final section\[/spoiler].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the credits music wouldn’t play after completing all levels (\[spoiler]if the final zone had been completed\[/spoiler]).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the camera would zoom in on unintended areas in 2-Player mode.[/p][/*][/list]
